review.posthog_relevance: Desktop application update delivery and user communication
review.reason: Adds the missing dependency, conditional trigger, and documentation for the in-app update modal. This establishes the complete implementation path for the update flow, allowing PostHog Desktop users to receive and acknowledge updates rather than just seeing a toast. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.

observations.behavior: Adds an import for the update modal store.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check to open the update modal when an update outcome indicates it.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation for the in-app update banner and modal behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the expected behavior of the update banner and modal, including states and accessibility, for PostHog desktop users.
